command: CREATE DATABASE lesson CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
CREATE TABLE lesson.shared_rows(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n INT NULL,KEY n_idx(n)) ENGINE=InnoDB ROW_FORMAT=COMPACT
CREATE TABLE lesson.private_rows(id INT PRIMARY KEY,n INT NULL,marker VARCHAR(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin,KEY n_idx(n)) ENGINE=InnoDB ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC

SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_OBJECT('version',VERSION(),'page_size',@@innodb_page_size,'checksum',@@innodb_checksum_algorithm,'file_per_table',@@innodb_file_per_table,'undo_tablespaces',@@innodb_undo_tablespaces,'doublewrite',@@innodb_doublewrite,'data_file_path',@@innodb_data_file_path,'datadir',@@datadir,'change_buffering',@@innodb_change_buffering) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4))

SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_OBJECT('name',NAME,'table_id',TABLE_ID,'space',SPACE,'flags',FLAG,'row_format',ROW_FORMAT,'columns',N_COLS) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_SYS_TABLES WHERE NAME LIKE 'lesson/%' ORDER BY NAME

SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_OBJECT('table',t.NAME,'name',i.NAME,'id',i.INDEX_ID,'root',i.PAGE_NO,'space',i.SPACE,'type',i.TYPE,'fields',i.N_FIELDS) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_SYS_INDEXES i JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_SYS_TABLES t ON i.TABLE_ID=t.TABLE_ID WHERE t.NAME LIKE 'lesson/%' ORDER BY t.NAME,i.INDEX_ID
SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(id,n) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) FROM lesson.shared_rows ORDER BY id
SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_ARRAY(id,n,marker) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) FROM lesson.private_rows ORDER BY id

SELECT HEX(CAST(JSON_OBJECT('name',NAME,'id',INDEX_ID,'root',PAGE_NO,'space',SPACE) AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4)) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_SYS_INDEXES WHERE TABLE_ID IN (1,2,3,4) ORDER BY TABLE_ID,INDEX_ID
